Debate on Annual Budget Statement

3,856 of 4,639 sentences in this record
Mr Liang Eng Hwa
New and enhanced enterprise schemes

The Finance Minister introduced new schemes, extended existing ones, and streamlined eight ESG financing schemes into a single Enterprise Financing Scheme.

  2. s00003 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Liang Eng Hwa — Holland-Bukit Timah

    Besides new schemes, such as Scale‐up SG, Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) Co‐Investment Fund III and the Innovation Agent Programme, the Finance Minister has also extended and enhanced existing schemes, such as the Enterprise Development Grant (EDG), the Productivity Solutions Grant (PSG) and others, with the intent to boost effectiveness and reap better outcomes.

  3. s00004 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Liang Eng Hwa — Holland-Bukit Timah

    Eight existing financing schemes offered by Enterprise Singapore (ESG) were also streamlined into a single Enterprise Financing Scheme (EFS), making it simpler for businesses to apply and easier to access the loans.

    Honouring Merdeka women's sacrifices

    More Merdeka men than women signing up for CareShield Life because of the gender gap would be a perverse outcome.

    1. s01310 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong — Non-Constituency Membercontext

    2. s01311 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong — Non-Constituency Member

    • Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
    Calibrating policies for seniors

    The speaker proposes calibrating healthcare, manpower, pension, housing and gender policies so seniors age with independence, listing five specific measures.

    1. s01319 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong — Non-Constituency Membercontext

      We need and we should calibrate our healthcare, manpower, social pension, housing and gender policies to make sure our seniors age with independence.

    2. s01320 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong — Non-Constituency Member

      I have made the case that: one, CHAS auto-enrollment and outpatient subsidies should kick in for all Singaporeans who turn 60 years old to plug the primary care gap in our universal healthcare system; two, the retirement age be removed, the redefined re-employment age raised to 70 years old and the CPF contribution for older workers restored so that our seniors can continue working as long as they can and want; three, CPF be transformed into a safety net for seniors, that payout eligibility age be lowered to 60 years old and members be allowed to make partial withdrawals if incapacitated to work for a period of time; four, ageing in place be deepened by promoting the Lease Buyback Scheme to the Merdekas; and five, close the gender gap in CPF and other savings for our senior women by increasing the MediSave top-ups for them and the participation incentive for them to enrol in CareShield Life.

    3. s01321 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong — Non-Constituency Member

      If we have missed our chances with the Pioneers, we should not miss this opportunity with the Merdekas.

    5. s01323 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong — Non-Constituency Member

      We owe it to the Merdekas that they age with independence.

    SEC for special needs workers

    1. s02344 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar — Ang Mo Kio

      The SEC and Additional SEC should also be extended in helping business owners employ those with special needs and those with mental health challenges who may need time and space to adjust to their work environments and work commitments.

      While I support the funding for the enhanced Professional Conversion Programme (PCP) and Career Support Programme (CSP) to continue, I would like to find out how effective have our PCP, Career Trial, CSP, and Adapt and Grow Programme been in helping PMEs secure employment?

    2. s02360 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar — Ang Mo Kio

      However, are there plans to lower road taxes for electric vehicles and providing similar rebates for owners of electric vehicles which are much more environmentally friendly with zero carbon emissions?

    2. s02371 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar — Ang Mo Kio

      First, this year's Budget allocates funds and incentives that are rather generous to support entrepreneurs who are expanding their enterprise or businesses across the border, whether in Southeast Asia or globally.

    4. s02373 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar — Ang Mo Kio

    1. s02412 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang — Nee Soon

      Of these students, only 10 to 20 of them eventually move on to the Express stream.

    • Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
    Subject-Based Banding replacing primary streaming

    In 2008, MOE replaced primary school streaming with Subject-Based Banding, keeping the good parts of streaming and cutting the bad parts.

    2. s02453 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang — Nee Soon

    Subject-Based Banding in secondary schools

    The reasons for replacing primary streaming with Subject-Based Banding should apply to secondary schools, and Subject-Based Banding has been expanded to all secondary schools.

    1. s02456 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang — Nee Sooncontext

    2. s02457 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang — Nee Soon

      We have already expanded Subject-Based Banding to all secondary schools to benefit more students.

    2. s02471 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang — Nee Soon

    1. s02474 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Ms Sylvia Lim — Aljuniedcontext

    2. s02475 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Ms Sylvia Lim — Aljunied

      He concludes that, for individuals, globalisation has brought about divergent changes in real income.

    3. s02476 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Ms Sylvia Lim — Aljunied

      The "winners" included the bottom third of income earners, the middle classes of the emerging market economies in China, India and Indonesia, and the global top 1%.

    4. s02477 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Ms Sylvia Lim — Aljunied

      The "losers" were the middle class of the old OECD countries, and the poorest 5%.

    2. s02550 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Terence Ho Wee San — Nominated Member

    3. s02551 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Terence Ho Wee San — Nominated Membercontext

    5. s02553 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Terence Ho Wee San — Nominated Member

    6. s02554 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Terence Ho Wee San — Nominated Member

    • Mr Zaqy Mohamad
    Services DRC and S Pass cuts

    1. s02693 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

    • Mr Zaqy Mohamad
    EP holders and Fair Consideration

    EP holders declined by 3% or 6,400 since tightening; 2017 adjustment effects continue in 2019, so EP policy is unchanged this year, and the Fair Consideration Framework was strengthened.

    1. s02710 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

      The number of EP holders has declined by 3% or 6,400 since the tightening.

    2. s02711 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

      As some effects of the adjustment in 2017 will continue to be felt in 2019, we have not made any changes to the EP policy this year.

    4. s02713 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

      To support fair hiring of local PMETs, we have also strengthened the Fair Consideration Framework (FCF).

    • Mr Zaqy Mohamad
    Calibrating foreign worker inflow

    Calibrating the inflow of foreign workers in the Services sector is necessary to sustain the impetus for restructuring.

    1. s02722 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

      Calibrating the inflow of foreign workers in the Services sector is necessary to sustain the impetus for restructuring.

    • Mr Zaqy Mohamad
    DRC cuts phased in

    The DRC is reduced, phased in over two years, so firms hire more locals or become manpower-lean.

    1. s02738 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamadcontext

      However, we must start somewhere to build deep enterprise and human capabilities so that businesses can remain competitive regionally and globally.

    2. s02739 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

      This is why we chose to reduce the DRC as opposed to simply raising levies.

    4. s02741 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

      With a lower DRC, firms will have to either hire more locals or transform their businesses to become more manpower-lean.

    6. s02743 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

      To help firms manage the changes, we are phasing in the DRC cuts, in two steps over two years, to give firms some more time to prepare.

    • Mr Zaqy Mohamad
    Lean Enterprise Development scheme flexibilities

    Firms needing more time can access transitional manpower flexibilities under the Lean Enterprise Development scheme.

    1. s02749 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad

      For firms that require more time to grow the local pipeline or transit into new manpower-lean models, firms can access transitional manpower flexibilities under the Lean Enterprise Development (LED) scheme.

    3. s02779 · 1099+1101+1103+1106+1109Mr Zaqy Mohamad
